title: termal_read_mailbox returns the reader's own sent messages in full
outcome: Reported by Engram::Fable (2026-09-27, mailbox-703fddd4 #2). The reader's own 9 KB project review came back in full on its next read (mailbox-e3d12b08-a6c6-4fe2-b247-6a2911631303, sequence 25). Own sends cost context on every read that spans them. Request: return own sends as a header only (sequence, topic, time), with the body available on request (termal_read_mailbox_message).
acceptance: A mailbox range read through TermAl's MCP returns messages sent by the reading session without body and with bodyOmitted:true, while preserving their message IDs, sequence, topic and creation time; incoming bodies and the page receipt/cursor/paging metadata remain unchanged.

termal_read_mailbox_message can retrieve the full durable body of such an own message by messageId; the omission is confined to the MCP range-read projection and does not mutate durable messages or change receipt acknowledgement.
